0416Wholesale and retail sales

Retail Inventory Optimization Environment

Space · saketh1201/quartermaster-env

Manage a 30-day retail store: buy, choose shipping speed, liquidate and set prices across five products to maximise profit.

Open on Hugging FaceHow to run it

Good for

  • long-horizon business simulation
  • profit-normalised grading

Reward

How it is scored
Programmatic check
Signal
Graded, 0 to 1

Score = (agent profit - floor) / (ceiling - floor), clamped to [0,1], against deterministic passive and perfect-knowledge baselines; plus per-step decomposed rewards.

How to run it

1. From the cardcopied from the publisher's own instructions

curl "http://localhost:8000/baseline"

2. Run the Space locallyevery Space is a Docker image or app you can clone

git clone https://huggingface.co/spaces/saketh1201/quartermaster-env
cd quartermaster-env

The Space also runs live on the Hub; open it to see the API it serves.

Framework documentation: OpenEnv.

Evidence

A baseline LLM run on the easy task scored 0.822.

As reported by the publisher. We have not reproduced it.
